CREATE FUNCTION nested_sql_function(i integer) RETURNS integer LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$ SELECT sum(r.n) FROM (VALUES(i),(i+2)) a(n), LATERAL (SELECT a.n) r JOIN (VALUES(1)) b(m) ON true $$
SELECT nested_sql_function(7) AS first, nested_sql_function(2) AS second

CREATE FUNCTION nested_atomic_function(i integer) RETURNS integer LANGUAGE sql STABLE BEGIN ATOMIC SELECT sum(r.n) FROM (VALUES(i),(i+2)) a(n), LATERAL (SELECT a.n) r JOIN (VALUES(1)) b(m) ON true; END
SELECT nested_atomic_function(7) AS first, nested_atomic_function(2) AS second
